title: Data Analyst
description:
Data Analyst - SQL, Databricks, Sustainability
up to £400pd (Inside IR35)
Remote
initially 6 months


The role will support the delivery of data and analytics solutions, working closely with business and technical stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into clear data requirements. The position will have a particular focus on sustainability and Product Carbon Footprint (PCF) data.
Key Requirements

  • Strong Data Analyst experience with excellent SQL skills.
  • Good understanding of Kimball methodology and dimensional data modelling.
  • Experience with Databricks and knowledge of Microsoft Azure data services.
  • Experience working with sustainability-related data and initiatives.
  • Knowledge or hands-on experience of Product Carbon Footprint (PCF).
  • Strong requirements gathering, clarification and documentation skills.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into clear data and technical requirements.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Comfortable working between business and technical/data teams.

Nice to Have

  • Broader experience across Azure-based data environments.
  • Experience delivering data solutions within complex enterprise environments.
  • Previous experience working on sustainability, carbon reporting or environmental data programmes.
